overview.description: The Direxion Daily S&P Biotech Bull 3X ETF (LABU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Biotechnology Select Industry index. The fund provides daily 3 times exposure to the S&P Biotechnology Select Industry Index. LABU was launched on May 28, 2015 and is issued by Direxion.
